name: os
doc:
os files (Go's os.File): Open/Create/OpenFile return a File that
implements io.Reader, Writer, Closer, Seeker (and ReadWriteCloser);
Stat/Lstat give FileInfo; ReadDir gives DirEntry values. The older
os functions (Args, Getenv, Exit, ...) are runtime externs.

Flag bits for OpenFile (combine with |): RDONLY, WRONLY, RDWR, APPEND,
CREATE, EXCL, SYNC, TRUNC (the constants os.O_RDONLY ...).
